build_mesh_refinement_head: build a MeshRefinementHead from config to iteratively refine 3D meshes using graph convolutions
create_mesh_refinement_stage: create a MeshRefinementStage with graph conv layers to predict vertex offsets for mesh refinement
run_mesh_head_forward: run the MeshRefinementHead forward pass with image features and meshes to get refined output meshes
test_padded_to_packed: test the _padded_to_packed utility to convert padded vertex features to packed tensor format
review_mesh_refinement_stage_forward: review the MeshRefinementStage forward method that uses vert_align and graph convs to offset mesh vertices
